title: oadec loss report, version 2
description: What `oadec decode --format damf|adm --loss-report <file>` writes: the ledger of what the DAMF set or the ADM BWF file does not carry of the programme it was given. Version 2 names itself in `schema` and adds six kinds of loss (round 5); version 1, the report of oadec 0.9.1 before that, had no `schema` field and the first seventeen kinds. The writer is write_loss_report in crates/oadec-engine/src/damf.rs. The kinds and classes are LossKind and LossClass of crates/oadec-spatial/src/loss.rs, and crates/oadec-cli/tests/cli_loss_report.rs holds the two lists together.

schema.description: The version of this schema the report follows (REPORT_SCHEMA of crates/oadec-spatial/src/loss.rs).

target.description: The output the ledger is of.

declared_loss.description: Whether any loss of the class declared-loss was recorded: the case that sets exit code 4 (docs/exit-codes.md).

losses.description: One entry per kind with a count above zero, in reporting order (the order of `kind` below); empty when nothing was lost.

ramp_sources.description: For ramp-replaced: the source ramp length in samples, as a decimal string, against the number of events whose ramp of that length was replaced. Empty when no ramp was replaced.

overrides.description: The measurement overrides of the JOC reconstruction the run was given (E-AC-3 JOC only); always present, empty when there were none.

examples.description: The first losses recorded, at most three. A loss that belongs to the whole payload or programme (warp mode, trim configurations, alternate object data, unknown elements, bed channel distribution, reserved data, the sample rate) has element 0.

element.description: DAMF element id: bed channels 0 to 9 and 130 up, dynamic objects 10 up; for isf-dropped, and for additional-table-data-dropped on an ISF object, the index of the ISF object; 0 for a payload-wide loss.

sample.description: Sample position in the output, from its first sample.

kind.description: LossKind::name. The class of each is fixed: profile-reduction for ramp-replaced, importance-omitted, bed-event-dropped, bed-gain-dropped, screen-reference-dropped, trim-bypass-dropped; unrepresentable for distance-dropped, divergence-dropped, trim-config-dropped, additional-table-data-dropped, alternate-object-data-dropped, unknown-element-dropped, bed-distribute-dropped, reserved-data-dropped; approximation for warp-mode-dropped, size-axes-collapsed, late-first-event-held, same-position-superseded, event-beyond-end-dropped, reserved-zone-read-as-all; declared-loss for isf-dropped, out-of-order-written-as-is, non-profile-sample-rate.

class.description: LossClass::name. Only declared-loss sets an exit code (4).

flag.description: The hidden flag, without its dashes.

value.description: What the flag was given: an integer for joc-lag, text otherwise.

default.description: What the decode uses without the flag: an integer for joc-lag, text otherwise.
